name: shadcn/ui
notes: Not a traditional npm dependency: the CLI copies component source code into your project (init then add). v4 docs (repo main, apps/v4) organize components under three primitive variants: radix (default, 65 mdx), base (Base UI, 64; no sonner) and aria (ARIA-only, 63; no menubar/navigation-menu); this list is the union = the radix/default set (65). Legacy Form component is superseded by Field; Toast now coexists with Sonner. Chart uses Recharts, Data Table uses TanStack Table, Carousel uses Embla, Drawer uses Vaul. Descriptions taken verbatim from the frontmatter of each component mdx on repo main; the deployed site may differ slightly (e.g. /docs/components/typography is branded 'Typeset' live but titled 'Typography' in the repo).
